title: Whatever Happened to Class 3?

pre.en: What does Chen suggest for the next reunion?
pre.zh: 小陈建议下次同学聚会怎么办？
options: Meeting at the old noodle stall

intro: 小陈去不了中学同学会，在微信上给组织聚会的老同学刘洋发了一长串消息：机票太贵、和老同学断了联系、大家后来都怎么样了。读的时候留意 by the time、before、after 和过去完成时连用：「等到……的时候，……已经……了」。最后是刘洋的回复，揭开了一本书的下落。

sentences.en: Hi Liu Yang, thanks for the invitation!
sentences.zh: 刘洋，谢谢你的邀请！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I can't believe it's been fifteen years since we left secondary school.
sentences.zh: 真不敢相信，我们中学毕业已经十五年了。

sentences.en: I'd love to come on 19 December, but I've worked out the flight would cost more than two months' rent.
sentences.zh: 我很想 12 月 19 号回去，可我算了一下，机票比我两个月的房租还贵。

sentences.en: So I'm afraid I can't make it.
sentences.zh: 所以恐怕是去不了了。

sentences.en: We grew up together, but to be honest, I lost touch with most of Class 3 after university.
sentences.zh: 我们是一起长大的，可说实话，上了大学以后，我和三班大部分人都断了联系。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: By the time I moved to the UK last year, half of you had settled down in Shanghai or Shenzhen.
sentences.zh: 等我去年搬到英国的时候，你们一半人都已经在上海或深圳安家了。

sentences.en: And I'd stopped reading the group chat long before that, so I've missed most of the news.
sentences.zh: 群聊我早就不看了，所以大部分消息都错过了。

sentences.en: Still, I've heard from a few people on WeChat, and some of the news is amazing.
sentences.zh: 不过，微信上倒是有几个人跟我联系过，有些消息真让人想不到。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Shi Qiang had failed maths twice before he finally passed, and now he's a maths teacher!
sentences.zh: 石强当年数学挂了两次才过，现在居然当上了数学老师！

sentences.en: And Zhang Min had had twins before most of us had even found a job.
sentences.zh: 张敏呢，我们大多数人还没找到工作，她就已经生了一对双胞胎。

sentences.en: Your old photos reminded me of so many things I hadn't thought about for years.
sentences.zh: 你发的老照片，让我想起了好多很多年都没想起过的事。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: The bike shed, and that noodle stall outside the gate.
sentences.zh: 车棚，还有校门外那个面摊。

sentences.en: I was fascinated by the way that man pulled noodles by hand.
sentences.zh: 那个大叔手工拉面的样子，我当年看得入了迷。

sentences.en: A bowl cost three yuan, which seemed too good to be true even then.
sentences.zh: 一碗才三块钱，就算在那时候也便宜得不像真的。

sentences.en: Mind you, it was very high in salt.
sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，咸得要命。

sentences.en: Oh, by the way, I still owe you ten yuan for noodles.
sentences.zh: 哦对了，我还欠你十块钱面钱。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I'll pay you back, I promise.
sentences.zh: 我会还你的，保证。

sentences.en: And do you remember my Harry Potter book, the one with the torn cover?
sentences.zh: 还有，你记得我那本《哈利·波特》吗？封面破了的那本。

sentences.en: It went missing in our final year, just after I'd lent it to someone in the class.
sentences.zh: 毕业那年它不见了，就在我把它借给班上某个人之后。

sentences.en: Anyway, here's my idea: next time, why don't we get together online, so I can join too?
sentences.zh: 总之，我有个主意：下次我们在网上聚一聚吧，这样我也能参加。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It's my only offer — take it or leave it.
sentences.zh: 我就这一个提议——要不要随你。

sentences.en: Say hi to everyone for me!
sentences.zh: 替我向大家问声好！

sentences.en: Before you ask — yes, I've still got your Harry Potter book.
sentences.zh: 不等你问我就先说了——对，你那本《哈利·波特》还在我这儿。
sentences.speaker: Liu Yang

sentences.en: No, I haven't finished it.
sentences.zh: 没，我还没看完。

cards.note: 动词 invite；接受邀请是 accept an invitation。
to do exercise to make your body stronger and fitter
也能当动词：rent a flat（租房）。
to change from a child into an adult
cards.tip: 说在哪儿长大用 grow up in / on；名词 grown-up 是「大人」。别说 grow up a child，「养大孩子」是 bring up。
cards.example: I grew up in a small town by the sea.

cards.note: to stop talking to or writing to someone, so that you no longer know what they are doing
cards.tip: touch 前面不加 the；反义是 keep in touch with / stay in touch with。
cards.example: I lost touch with my university friends when I moved abroad.

cards.note: to start living a quiet life in one place, often with a partner, a home and a steady job
cards.tip: 常带「结婚、买房、不再到处跑」的意思；对孩子说 settle down 是「安静下来」。
cards.example: After years of travelling, she settled down in Edinburgh.

cards.note: to get a message, letter, email or call from someone
cards.tip: hear from sb 是对方联系了你；hear about sth 是听说某事；hear of sb 是听说过有这么个人。
cards.example: Have you heard from the bank about your loan yet?

cards.note: 单数 twin：my twin sister（我的双胞胎姐妹）。
to make someone remember or think about something or someone
cards.tip: remind sb of sth 是「让人想起」；remind sb to do 是「提醒某人去做」，别混。
cards.example: This song always reminds me of my first car.

cards.note: market stall 市场摊位；street food stall 街边小吃摊。
to be extremely interested in something
cards.tip: 人着迷用 fascinated，让人着迷的东西用 fascinating：The trains were fascinating.
cards.example: As a child, I was fascinated by trains.

cards.note: 比 interested 强得多，说人；fascinating 是「让人着迷的」，说事物。

cards.zh: 好得令人难以置信（多半有诈）
cards.note: so good that you think there must be a problem with it
cards.tip: 常跟在 seem、sound、look 后面；多带「小心有诈」的意思，这里是半开玩笑。
cards.example: A flat in the city centre for £400 a month? It sounds too good to be true.

cards.note: to contain a lot of something, such as sugar, fat or salt
owe sb sth：I owe you one.（我欠你一个人情。）
to give someone back the money that you owe them
cards.tip: sb 放在 pay 和 back 中间；还多少钱：pay sb back £20 / pay the money back。
cards.example: Can you lend me twenty pounds? I'll pay you back on Friday.

cards.note: tear（撕）的过去分词：tear – tore – torn。
to disappear, so that nobody knows where something or someone is
过去式、过去分词 lent。借出是 lend，借入是 borrow。
to meet in order to spend time together or do something together
cards.tip: 和谁聚用 with：get together with old friends；名词 get-together 是「小聚会」。
cards.example: We should get together for a drink after the holidays.

cards.note: said when you will not change an offer and the other person must accept it or refuse it
